# Chapter 15: The Y2K Challenge

*From BookSource.txt, Page 98*

December 31, 1999. The entire world held its breath, waiting to see if computers would destroy civilization as we knew it.

The Y2K bug - that harmless-sounding problem where computers might think the year 2000 was actually 1900 - had become the center of everyone's attention. Newspapers ran scared stories. People stockpiled supplies. Some folks even built bomb shelters.

And me? I was in my element.
